observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale on a checkerboard. South is a rounded, dome-shaped mound of pale grey-white hair with a pale central fall and four thick padded legs underneath. East is a long barrel body seen from the side, white ropy hair with clear green lichen mats over the back and legs, a blunt hair-covered mound at the right end and trailing strands at the left. North is a narrower view of the rear, a ridge of lichen along the spine, the haunches, a central fall of white cords, and two hind feet. No face appears on any facing. South looks wider and its lichen looks greyer than on east and north.
observed.south.png: A front view of a dome of glossy white-grey hair in wet-looking ropes, with dripping, icicle-like tips along the lower edge. A pale central fall of hair covers the front, and there are no eyes, horns or muzzle. Grey, frosty-looking lichen clumps sit on the shoulders and flanks; they read as grey rather than green. Two very thick front legs with large padded, toe-lobed feet are plainly visible, and the hind feet show behind them. Clean black alpha, with no ground or shadow.
observed.east.png: A side profile of a heavy barrel-bodied quadruped about twice as long as it is tall. The body is covered in long white, glossy, ropy hair. Olive-green lichen mats lie in drifts across the back, shoulders, haunch and legs, with loose green strands trailing down at the left end and from the legs. The right end is a blunt, rounded mound of hanging white hair with no face, which I take to be the front. All four short, thick legs show below the hair line, with dark grey padded feet. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: A rear view, narrower than south. A spine ridge carries green lichen patches running back to rounded haunches. A central fall of white cords hangs between the haunches, standing in for a tail. Two hind legs with dark padded feet. No face or eyes. The background is white or transparent, with a clean cut-out.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom (140 px/cell) the durrok is about 2 cells long and a bit shorter than the vanilla human, a low, wide white mass. At 32 px/cell it reads as a pale grey-white oblong blob with legs, clearly apart from the brown ground and next to the human and the rat.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the blunt front end: a dome of hair facing the camera with both front legs forward. It has no face, as the description intends. Its central white hair fall looks a lot like the rear's cord fall, so the front/rear difference is slight.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the spine ridge, the haunches and a fall of white cords between the hind legs. There are no eyes or face.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three facings are at the angled game camera. On south and north the back is foreshortened, with the legs visible under the body. None is a top-down view.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured height spread is 12%, within 15%. In facings.png the north looks narrower than the south, but its height is comparable.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The body, the white ropy hair and the padded feet match on every facing. The lichen is clearly olive-green on east and north but greyish and frost-like on south, a small palette drift that I report as polish.

SIGNATURE.seen: The drowned-haystack look is legible on every facing: no visible head, long pale glossy rope-hair to the ground, and lichen drifts.

ALIEN.seen: It resembles a giant corded komondor or a musk ox. The complete lack of any head, neck or face, plus the lichen mats, make it read as alien rather than as that dog.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1 No head or neck: present on all facings. 2 Long pale glossy wet-looking ropes to the ground: present. 3 Grey-green lichen drifts with trailing strands: present on east and north, weaker and greyer on south. 4 No real tail, only a fall of white cords: present on north. 5 Low barrel body on short thick legs that barely show: partly. The barrel body and short thick legs are there, but the legs and large padded feet show plainly on every facing, especially south, rather than barely showing under the hair.

STYLE.seen: Painterly and realistic, with fine hair strands and a wet sheen. Not cute or cel-shaded, and not a photo or 3D render. The outline is soft rather than a clean dark line, but it is still readable.

OURS.seen: The texture path is RM_Durrok's own folder. The painted style matches this project's generated art, not a vanilla or another mod's stand-in. The card's '(RimStarWars/SWBestiary)' note names where the def came from, which is not certain to be where the art came from.

ALPHA.seen: Real alpha on every facing, with no ground patch, water, shadow or halo.

SCALE.seen: About 2 cells long and a little below human height, which fits a low, plodding, smaller-than-wetland-kin beast.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it is a bright pale oblong mass with dark feet, clearly apart from the ground. The lichen detail is lost at that size, but the silhouette reads.
